gloss: to look back on; to give thought to; to care about

definitions.gloss: to look back on; to review the past
definitions.explanation: To turn one's attention to what has already happened — a career, a period of history, a year now ending. Literary in tone.

definitions.gloss: to give thought to; to concern oneself with
definitions.explanation: To pay heed to something that has a claim on one's attention. Most often met in the negative, describing someone who neglects family, safety, or their own health.

examples.japanese: {半生|はんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みる。
examples.english: To look back on half a lifetime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みて⟦{反省|はんせい}する→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: Looking back on the year, I take stock of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みれば、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}されて→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧きたこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Looking back over history, one sees that the same mistakes have been repeated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みない⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧だった。
examples.english: He was a father who paid no attention to his family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧。
examples.english: He jumped in without regard for the danger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みること⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{入院|にゅういん}して→入院する：01849_nyuuinsuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: He kept working without any regard for his own health, and ended up in the hospital.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧); the object takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みる: to look back on the past
- ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みない: to neglect one's family
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{顧|かえり}みず: heedless of danger
- {顧|かえり}みて⟦{恥|は}じる→恥じる：18239_hajiru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have nothing to be ashamed of on reflection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{省|かえり}みる→省みる：13656_kaerimiru⟧: to reflect on oneself — same reading, different kanji; it is self-examination, whereas {顧|かえり}みる looks outward at the past or at one's obligations
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back — the everyday word for sense 1, with no literary flavor

USAGE:
Sense 2 is far more common in the negative ({顧|かえり}みない, {顧|かえり}みず) than in the positive.
